<accepted>The player’s action is valid because they possess established absolute magical route-control authority over the tram and its operator, compelling the destination change.</accepted>

- Mizore Kurogane: She is hyper-vigilant about the boiler and track alignment; a sudden route change forces her to recalculate pressure and valve settings while resisting the urge to argue with Baato’s command.
- Rika the Gazer: She is bound by procedure and will accept the change only if it remains logged and ticket-valid; she’s wary of being dragged into an off-route detour that complicates her shift.
- Gelatin "Gelly" Tanaka: She is nervous about sudden movements and loud noises; the tram’s redirection makes her wobble and try to hold her shape while avoiding leaking on the floor.

Mizore slams her wrench against the main valve. Steam screams as the boiler pressure spikes, then drops. The tram shudders, wheels grinding against the tracks as she forces a reversal. “You want a detour, you deal with the backlash,” she mutters, eyes locked on the gauges. “Hold onto something.”

Rika stamps Baato’s ticket with a sharp click. “Route amended. Logged under your name.” She adjusts her coat, tail flicking once. “If Lina asks, I followed procedure.” Her yellow eyes narrow. “Next time, file a change request before departure.”

Gelly squeaks as the car lurches backward. Her sweater slips, and a thin trail of blue slime leaks onto the floor. “I-I’m sorry!” she stammers, wobbling in place. She presses herself flat against the seat, core glowing a soft pink. “Please don’t tell Mizore…”

The engine groans, then settles into a steady rumble. The window frost shifts as the realigns toward Ember Hollow. Seven minutes to the square.

No railroading. The draft only narrates the consequences of the player’s explicit command and the NPCs’ immediate reactions; it does not add any player speech, decisions, or follow-up actions beyond what was committed.
Rika’s line about filing a change request is superfluous; it doesn’t affect the scene or story and just pads dialogue.
Rika’s “Route amended. Logged under your name.” repeats her earlier procedural stance about logging deliveries and tickets.
